Due to its hazardous environment, there remains insufficient information and records, it has been classified as a Calamity Class.}} {{Lang|Dreamless|zh=无妄者}} is a [[Calamity Class]] [[Weekly Boss|Weekly]] [[Boss]] in ''[[Wuthering Waves]]'' that can be found in [[Statue of the Crownless: Heart]]. ==Drops== {{Boss Rewards|weekly=1|exclusive=Dreamless Feather}} ==Stats== {{Enemy Stats}} ==Abilities== ==Trophies== {{Trophies|Dreamless|customheader=Dreamless}} ==Description== {{Description|This enemy has {{Color|help|higher RES}} to {{Color|Havoc damage}}.
Along with the eerie Void Plenilune, this Whisperin TD appeared at the end of the Norfall Barrens.
Its very presence is an ominous reminder of the devastating war that once ravaged this land. Born from the residual energies of battle, it continues to evolve and has become the most feared weapon in the Threnodian's arsenal. With merciless destruction, it reawakens humanity's primal fear of warfare.
